title: Channel QR smart card response (PRF-02, catalogue module #10)
description: The creator-facing read/write response for the QR Smart Card. Owner decision, 2026-09-17: 'The creator sets one destination and one label. The card shows or hides on a single toggle. That is the entire feature.' No scene profile, no CMP-17 (Clutch Mode) dependency, no destination allow-list, no link shortening, and no scan/view/impression/exposure counter field exists anywhere in this contract, and additionalProperties false is what keeps it that way.

destination.description: Rendered client-side as a first-party QR code image. Data, never a link the Master Canvas runtime fetches, navigates to or embeds (9.1.1).
